tools.name: real_estate_website_builder
tools.description: Designs and writes the complete multi-page website of a real-estate office or property developer (home with a 3D hero, listings with search, services, about, contact with WhatsApp) from its name, city and services, in any language, and returns a link where the owner sees it now. No account: the draf

tools.name: real_estate_website_check
tools.description: Scores a real-estate office’s or developer’s current website (0–100) on what brings clients: secure address, speed, phone screens, search title and description, WhatsApp and call buttons, structured data, share picture, a form, languages. Reads only the one public page given. Pair it with real_estat

tools.name: commission_calculator
tools.description: Computes a real-estate broker’s commission on a deal: the commission, the tax on the commission (VAT is on the commission, not the property), the split with a co-broker office and the agent’s share. Works with any currency.

tools.name: lease_agreement
tools.description: Writes a residential or commercial lease agreement (Arabic or English) from the landlord, tenant, premises, rent and term, ready to print. A guide template.

tools.name: property_listing_writer
tools.description: Writes a property listing description (Arabic, English or French) from the facts given only — it never invents a feature, a number or a landmark.
